description: Urban Waste Water Agglomerations causing a key pollution pressure on rivers or lakes is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environmental Protection Agency. This shows the urban areas where waste water discharges were identified as the sole pollution pressure on water bodies at risk of not achieving good status. You can get more information on the status of local water bodies, and the environmental pressures which may be causing problems on the www.catchments.ie website. Coverage: Ireland. The portal files it under the publisher Environmental Protection Agency. Its tags are environment, government, ie, industrial waste, plant locations. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTML, JSON, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
